sr.q: Kako se zove prostirka na kojoj se trenira džudo?
opts: Tatami
Šindan
Dohyō
Springboard
sr.exp: Tatami je specijalna mekana prostirka, obavezna za svaki džudo trening. Štiti džudoke od povreda pri padovima.

en.q: What is the mat called where judo is practised?
opts: Tatami
Shindan
Dohyo
Springboard
en.exp: Tatami is a special soft mat, required for every judo session. It protects judoka from injuries during falls.

de.q: Wie heißt die Matte, auf der Judo trainiert wird?
opts: Tatami
Shindan
Dohyo
Sprungbrett
de.exp: Tatami ist eine spezielle Weichmatte, die bei jedem Judo-Training vorgeschrieben ist. Sie schützt Judoka vor Verletzungen beim Fallen.

fr.q: Comment s'appelle le tapis sur lequel on pratique le judo?
opts: Tatami
Shindan
Dohyo
Trampoline
fr.exp: Le tatami est un tapis spécial obligatoire pour chaque entraînement de judo. Il protège les judokas des blessures lors des chutes.

es.q: ¿Cómo se llama la colchoneta donde se practica el judo?
opts: Tatami
Shindan
Dohyo
Trampolín
es.exp: El tatami es una colchoneta especial obligatoria en cada entrenamiento de judo. Protege a los judokas de lesiones durante las caídas.

it.q: Come si chiama il tappeto su cui si pratica il judo?
opts: Tatami
Shindan
Dohyo
Trampolino
it.exp: Il tatami è un tappeto speciale obbligatorio per ogni allenamento di judo. Protegge i judoka dalle lesioni durante le cadute.

pt.q: Como se chama o tatame onde se pratica judô?
opts: Tatami
Shindan
Dohyo
Trampolim
pt.exp: O tatami é um tapete especial obrigatório em cada treino de judô. Protege os judocas de lesões durante as quedas.

ru.q: What is the mat called where judo is practised?
opts: Tatami
Shindan
Dohyo
Springboard
ru.exp: Tatami is a special soft mat, required for every judo session. It protects judoka from injuries during falls.

sr.q: Šta znači 'Rei' u džudou?
opts: Naklon/pozdrav
Tehnika bacanja
Vrsta hvata
Sudijska komanda
sr.exp: Rei je naklon – osnova bontona u džudou. Radimo ga kada ulazimo na tatami, pre i posle borbe, i prema senseiju.

en.q: What does 'Rei' mean in judo?
opts: Bow/greeting
Throwing technique
Type of grip
Referee command
en.exp: Rei is a bow – the cornerstone of judo etiquette. We bow when entering the Tatami, before and after contests, and toward the Sensei.

de.q: Vor dem Betreten der Matte – was müssen wir tun?
opts: Verbeugen
Kurz dehnen
'OSS' rufen
Den Sensei fragen
de.exp: Die Verbeugung (Rei) beim Betreten und Verlassen der Tatami ist Respekt gegenüber dem Dojo.

fr.q: Avant de monter sur le tatami, que devons-nous faire?
opts: S'incliner
Faire quelques étirements
Crier 'OSS'
Demander la permission au sensei
fr.exp: La révérence (Rei) en entrant et en quittant le tatami est un signe de respect envers le dojo.

es.q: Antes de subir al tatami, ¿qué debemos hacer?
opts: Hacer una reverencia
Hacer estiramientos cortos
Gritar 'OSS'
Pedir permiso al sensei
es.exp: La reverencia (Rei) al entrar y salir del tatami es una señal de respeto hacia el dojo.

it.q: Prima di salire sul tatami, cosa dobbiamo fare?
opts: Fare un inchino
Fare alcuni allungamenti
Gridare 'OSS'
Chiedere il permesso al sensei
it.exp: L'inchino (Rei) all'entrata e all'uscita dal tatami è un segno di rispetto verso il dojo.

pt.q: Antes de subir ao tatami, o que devemos fazer?
opts: Fazer uma reverência
Fazer alongamentos
Gritar 'OSS'
Pedir permissão ao sensei
pt.exp: A reverência (Rei) ao entrar e sair do tatami é um sinal de respeito ao dojo.

ru.q: Что означает 'Рэй' в дзюдо?
opts: Поклон/приветствие
Техника броска
Тип захвата
Команда арбитра
ru.exp: Рэй — поклон, основной знак уважения в дзюдо. К залу, партнёру и сенсею.

sr.q: Šta je 'Ukemi' u džudou?
opts: Tehnika pada
Tehnika bacanja
Vrsta pojasa
Pozdrav
sr.exp: Ukemi (ukemi-waza) su tehnike pada. Bez dobrog ukemi nema sigurnog džudoa – to je prva stvar koja se uči!

en.q: What is 'Ukemi' in judo?
opts: Breakfall technique
Throwing technique
Type of belt
Greeting
en.exp: Ukemi (ukemi-waza) are breakfall techniques. Without good Ukemi there is no safe judo – it is one of the first skills learned!

de.q: Was ist 'Ukemi' im Judo?
opts: Falltechnik
Wurftechnik
Gürtelart
Gruß
de.exp: Ukemi-waza sind Falltechniken – die sichere Art zu fallen, ohne sich zu verletzen. Die Grundlage jedes Judo-Trainings.

fr.q: Qu'est-ce que l'Ukemi en judo?
opts: Technique de chute
Technique de projection
Type de ceinture
Salut
fr.exp: L'Ukemi-waza regroupe les techniques de chute – la manière sécurisée de tomber sans se blesser. Base de tout entraînement judo.

es.q: ¿Qué es el Ukemi en judo?
opts: Técnica de caída
Técnica de proyección
Tipo de cinturón
Saludo
es.exp: El Ukemi-waza agrupa las técnicas de caída – la manera segura de caer sin lesionarse. Base de todo entrenamiento de judo.

it.q: Cos'è l'Ukemi nel judo?
opts: Tecnica di caduta
Tecnica di proiezione
Tipo di cintura
Saluto
it.exp: L'Ukemi-waza raggruppa le tecniche di caduta – il modo sicuro di cadere senza farsi male. Base di ogni allenamento di judo.

pt.q: O que é Ukemi no judô?
opts: Técnica de queda
Técnica de projeção
Tipo de faixa
Saudação
pt.exp: O Ukemi-waza agrupa as técnicas de queda – a forma segura de cair sem se machucar. Base de todo treino de judô.

ru.q: Что такое Укэми в дзюдо?
opts: Техника падения
Техника броска
Тип пояса
Приветствие
ru.exp: Укэми-вадза — техники безопасного падения без травм. Основа любой тренировки по дзюдо.

sr.q: Šta znači 'Ippon' u borbi?
opts: Savršena pobeda koja donosi trenutnu i konačnu pobedu
Waza-ari koji vredi samo pola poena u borbi
Shido kazna za pasivnost ili kršenje pravila borbe
Yuko – niži rezultat koji je ponovo uveden u važeća pravila
sr.exp: Ippon je maksimalni rezultat i donosi trenutnu pobedu. Može se postići kvalitetnim bacanjem na leđa, zadržavanjem od 20 sekundi ili predajom protivnika.

en.q: What does 'Ippon' mean in a contest?
opts: Perfect victory – immediate win
Waza-ari (score below Ippon)
Shido (penalty)
Yuko – a lower score used under the current rules
en.exp: Ippon is the maximum score and ends the contest immediately. It can be awarded for a high-quality throw onto the back, a 20-second hold or submission.

de.q: Was bedeutet 'Ippon' im Wettkampf?
opts: Perfekter Sieg – sofortiger Sieg
Waza-ari (halber Punkt)
Shido (Strafe)
Yuko (altes System)
de.exp: Ippon ist das Höchstergebnis – sofortiger Sieg. Durch perfekten Wurf auf den Rücken oder Haltegriff 20 Sekunden.

fr.q: Que signifie 'Ippon' en compétition?
opts: Victoire parfaite – victoire immédiate
Waza-ari (demi-point)
Shido (pénalité)
Yuko (ancien système)
fr.exp: L'Ippon est le score maximum – victoire immédiate. Obtenu par une projection parfaite sur le dos ou une immobilisation de 20 secondes.

es.q: ¿Qué significa 'Ippon' en competición?
opts: Victoria perfecta – victoria inmediata
Waza-ari (medio punto)
Shido (penalización)
Yuko (sistema antiguo)
es.exp: El Ippon es la puntuación máxima – victoria inmediata. Obtenida por una proyección perfecta sobre la espalda o una inmovilización de 20 segundos.

it.q: Cosa significa 'Ippon' in gara?
opts: Vittoria perfetta – vittoria immediata
Waza-ari (mezzo punto)
Shido (penalità)
Yuko (vecchio sistema)
it.exp: L'Ippon è il punteggio massimo – vittoria immediata. Ottenuta con una proiezione perfetta sulla schiena o un'immobilizzazione di 20 secondi.

pt.q: O que significa 'Ippon' em competição?
opts: Vitória perfeita – vitória imediata
Waza-ari (meio ponto)
Shido (penalidade)
Yuko (sistema antigo)
pt.exp: O Ippon é a pontuação máxima – vitória imediata. Obtida por uma projeção perfeita nas costas ou imobilização de 20 segundos.

ru.q: Что означает 'Иппон' в соревновании?
opts: Чистая победа — немедленная победа
Ваза-ари (полбалла)
Шидо (штраф)
Юко (старая система)
ru.exp: Иппон — максимальный результат, немедленная победа. Достигается чистым броском на спину или удержанием 20 секунд.

sr.q: Kako se zove odeća za džudo?
opts: Džudogi (kimono)
Karategi
Kimono budo
Trenerka
sr.exp: Džudogi je specijalna odeća za džudo – deblja i čvršća od karate gi, jer trpi hvatanje i vučenje.

en.q: What is the judo uniform called?
opts: Judogi (kimono)
Karategi
Budo kimono
Tracksuit
en.exp: Judogi is the special judo uniform – thicker and stronger than a karate gi, because it must withstand gripping and pulling.

de.q: Wie heißt der Judo-Anzug?
opts: Judogi (Kimono)
Karategi
Budo-Kimono
Trainingsanzug
de.exp: Judogi ist der offizielle Judo-Anzug aus Jacke, Hose und Gürtel. Weiß oder blau bei Wettkämpfen.

fr.q: Comment s'appelle la tenue de judo?
opts: Judogi (kimono)
Karategi
Kimono budo
Survêtement
fr.exp: Le judogi est la tenue officielle de judo, composée d'une veste, d'un pantalon et d'une ceinture. Blanc ou bleu en compétition.

es.q: ¿Cómo se llama el traje de judo?
opts: Judogi (kimono)
Karategi
Kimono budo
Chándal
es.exp: El judogi es la vestimenta oficial del judo, compuesta de chaqueta, pantalón y cinturón. Blanco o azul en competición.

it.q: Come si chiama la divisa del judo?
opts: Judogi (kimono)
Karategi
Kimono budo
Tuta sportiva
it.exp: Il judogi è la divisa ufficiale del judo, composta da giacca, pantaloni e cintura. Bianco o blu in gara.

pt.q: Como se chama o uniforme de judô?
opts: Judogi (quimono)
Karategi
Quimono budo
Agasalho
pt.exp: O judogi é o uniforme oficial do judô, composto de jaqueta, calça e faixa. Branco ou azul em competição.

ru.q: Как называется форма дзюдоиста?
opts: Дзюдоги (кимоно)
Каратеги
Будо-кимоно
Спортивный костюм
ru.exp: Дзюдоги — официальная форма дзюдо: куртка, брюки и пояс. Белая или синяя на соревнованиях.

sr.q: Ko je osnovao džudo sport?
opts: Jigoro Kano
Kyuzo Mifune
Isao Inokuma
Gichin Funakoshi
sr.exp: Jigoro Kano (1860-1938) je osnivač džudoa. Razvio ga je 1882. u Tokiju kombinujući stara jujutsu znanja.

en.q: Who founded judo?
opts: Jigoro Kano
Morihei Ueshiba
Gichin Funakoshi
Kyuzo Mifune
en.exp: Jigoro Kano (1860–1938) is the founder of judo. He developed it in 1882 in Tokyo by combining knowledge from ancient jujutsu schools.

de.q: Wer hat Judo gegründet?
opts: Jigoro Kano
Kyuzo Mifune
Masahiko Kimura
Yasuhiro Yamashita
de.exp: Jigoro Kano (1860–1938) gründete Judo 1882, basierend auf Jiu-Jitsu. Gründete das Kodokan in Tokio.

fr.q: Qui a fondé le judo?
opts: Jigoro Kano
Kyuzo Mifune
Masahiko Kimura
Yasuhiro Yamashita
fr.exp: Jigoro Kano (1860–1938) a fondé le judo en 1882, basé sur le Jiu-Jitsu traditionnel. Il a fondé le Kodokan à Tokyo.

es.q: ¿Quién fundó el judo?
opts: Jigoro Kano
Kyuzo Mifune
Masahiko Kimura
Yasuhiro Yamashita
es.exp: Jigoro Kano (1860–1938) fundó el judo en 1882, basado en el Jiu-Jitsu tradicional. Fundó el Kodokan en Tokio.

it.q: Chi ha fondato il judo?
opts: Jigoro Kano
Kyuzo Mifune
Masahiko Kimura
Yasuhiro Yamashita
it.exp: Jigoro Kano (1860–1938) fondò il judo nel 1882, basato sul Jiu-Jitsu tradizionale. Fondò il Kodokan a Tokyo.

pt.q: Quem fundou o judô?
opts: Jigoro Kano
Kyuzo Mifune
Masahiko Kimura
Yasuhiro Yamashita
pt.exp: Jigoro Kano (1860–1938) fundou o judô em 1882, baseado no Jiu-Jitsu tradicional. Fundou o Kodokan em Tóquio.

ru.q: Кто основал дзюдо?
opts: Дзигоро Кано
Кюдзо Мифунэ
Масахико Кимура
Ясухиро Ямасита
ru.exp: Дзигоро Кано (1860–1938) основал дзюдо в 1882 году на основе традиционного джиу-джитсу. Основал Кодокан в Токио.

sr.q: Koje bacanje koristi kukove kao oslonac?
opts: O-goshi
Seoi-nage
O-soto-gari
Tai-otoshi
sr.exp: O-goshi (veliki kuk) je klasično kuk-bacanje. Tori stavlja kuk ispod Uke-ovog težišta i baca ga preko njega.

en.q: Which throw uses the hip as the main pivot?
opts: O-goshi
Seoi-nage
O-soto-gari
Tai-otoshi
en.exp: O-goshi (major hip throw) is a classic hip throw. Tori places their hip beneath Uke's centre of mass and throws them over it.

de.q: Was ist Randori im Judo?
opts: Freies Übungssparring
Wettkampf
Kata-Form
Aufwärmübung
de.exp: Randori = 'freies Üben' – Sparring ohne festes Ergebnis. Beide Partner üben frei und wechseln Angriff und Verteidigung.

fr.q: Qu'est-ce que le Randori en judo?
opts: Pratique libre de sparring
Combat de compétition
Forme kata
Exercice d'échauffement
fr.exp: Randori = 'pratique libre' – sparring sans résultat fixe. Les deux partenaires pratiquent librement, alternant attaque et défense.

es.q: ¿Qué es el Randori en judo?
opts: Práctica libre de sparring
Combate de competición
Forma kata
Ejercicio de calentamiento
es.exp: Randori = 'práctica libre' – sparring sin resultado fijo. Ambos compañeros practican libremente, alternando ataque y defensa.

it.q: Cos'è il Randori nel judo?
opts: Pratica libera di sparring
Combattimento di gara
Forma kata
Esercizio di riscaldamento
it.exp: Randori = 'pratica libera' – sparring senza risultato fisso. Entrambi i partner praticano liberamente, alternando attacco e difesa.

pt.q: O que é Randori no judô?
opts: Prática livre de sparring
Combate de competição
Forma kata
Exercício de aquecimento
pt.exp: Randori = 'prática livre' – sparring sem resultado fixo. Ambos os parceiros praticam livremente, alternando ataque e defesa.

ru.q: Что такое Рандори в дзюдо?
opts: Свободная тренировка
Соревновательный бой
Форма ката
Упражнение разминки
ru.exp: Рандори = 'свободная практика' — спарринг без фиксированного результата. Оба партнёра практикуют свободно, чередуя атаку и защиту.

sr.q: Pre nego što stupimo na tatami, šta moramo uraditi?
opts: Nakloniti se
Uraditi kratko zagrevanje
Potrčati
Sedeti
sr.exp: Uvek se naklonimo kada ulazimo i izlazimo sa tatamija – to je osnova džudo bontona i poštovanja prostora za trening.

en.q: Before stepping onto the Tatami, what must we do?
opts: Bow
Do a short warm-up
Run
Sit down
en.exp: We always bow when entering and leaving the Tatami – this is the foundation of judo etiquette and respect for the training space.

sr.q: Šta treba da uradiš ako ti je teško na treningu?
opts: Nastaviti i truditi se
Smanjiti intenzitet
Zamoliti senseija za pauzu
Tražiti pauzu odmah
sr.exp: 'Nana korobi ya oki' – stara japanska poslovica: Padni sedam puta, ustani osam. To je džudo mentalitet!

en.q: What should you do when training gets really tough?
opts: Keep going and try hard
Reduce the intensity
Ask Sensei for a break
Stop immediately
en.exp: 'Nana korobi ya oki' – an old Japanese proverb: fall seven times, get up eight. That is the judo spirit!

sr.q: Šta je 'Tori' u džudou?
opts: Osoba koja izvodi tehniku
Uke – prima bacanje
Shimpan – sudija
Trener
sr.exp: Tori je osoba koja izvodi tehniku (baca, zadržava). Uke je partner koji prima tehniku. Uvek se smenjuju uloge.

en.q: What is 'Tori' in judo?
opts: The person actively performing and executing the judo technique
The person receiving and falling from the executed technique
The official referee who oversees and scores the judo match
The coaching staff member directing the judoka from the sideline
en.exp: Tori is the person performing the technique (throwing, pinning). Uke is the partner who receives it. Roles always alternate.

Chiedere il permesso al sensei

opts: Fazer uma reverência
Fazer alongamentos
Gritar 'OSS'
Pedir permissão ao sensei
pt.exp: A reverência (Rei) ao entrar e sair do tatami é um sinal de respeito ao dojo.

ru.q: Перед выходом на татами что нужно сделать?
opts: Поклониться
Сделать растяжку
Крикнуть 'ОСС'
Попросить разрешения у сенсея
ru.exp: Поклон (Рэй) при входе и выходе с татами — знак уважения к залу.

sr.q: Šta je 'Uke' u džudou?
opts: Osoba koja prima tehniku
Osoba koja napada
Vrsta bacanja
Tip pojasa
sr.exp: Uke je partner koji prima tehniku i pada. Uke mora dobro poznavati ukemi kako bi bio bezbedan.

en.q: What is 'Uke' in judo?
opts: The person receiving and falling from the executed judo technique
The person actively attacking and executing the throw technique
A specific category of throwing technique in the nage-waza group
A specific level or grade of judo belt worn around the waist
en.exp: Uke is the partner who receives the technique and falls. Uke must master Ukemi well in order to stay safe.

de.q: Was bedeutet 'Tori' im Judo?
opts: Der Ausführende der Technik
Der Fallende
Kampfrichter
Trainer
de.exp: Tori = der Ausführende der Technik. Uke = der Empfangende, der fällt. Rollen wechseln beim Training.

fr.q: Que signifie 'Tori' en judo?
opts: Celui qui exécute la technique
Celui qui tombe
L'arbitre
L'entraîneur
fr.exp: Tori = celui qui exécute la technique. Uke = celui qui reçoit la technique et tombe. Les rôles alternent.

es.q: ¿Qué significa 'Tori' en judo?
opts: El que ejecuta la técnica

Harai-goshi

de.q: Was ist das Bewegungsmuster bei Harai-goshi?

Tori greift den Nacken

Tori tombe en arrière
Tori saisit le cou

Tori agarra o pescoço

Tehnike bacanja
Tehnike gušenja
Stav i pokret

en.q: What does the term 'Ukemi-waza' mean?
opts: Breakfall and body-protection techniques that allow safe falling
Throwing techniques that send the opponent from standing to the mat
Neck-pressure techniques that force submission in groundwork
Overall body posture, balance and movement in judo practice
en.exp: Ukemi-waza = breakfall techniques. Mae-ukemi (forward), Ushiro-ukemi (backward), Yoko-ukemi (sideways), Zenpo-kaiten (forward roll).

Einarmwürger

Vremenska pauza

en.q: Your opponent holds a negative grip (gripping only your belt from behind without attacking). What can you request?

Attempt a throw immediately to score Ippon for yourself
Request a formal time-out from the referee to reset the situation
Nothing at all because this grip is fully permitted by the rules
en.exp: A negative grip with no intention to attack = Shido! A judo grip must serve attack or defence – avoiding gripping is penalised.

sr.q: Šta je De-ashi-barai?
opts: Čišćenje iskoračene noge u tačnom trenutku koraka protivnika
Unutrašnji podmet nogom od iznutra prema spolja
Kuk bacanje gde Tori rotira Ukea preko kukova
Rameno bacanje gdje Uke prelazi preko Torijevih ramena
sr.exp: De-ashi-barai ('čišćenje prednje noge') – briješimo Uke-ovu nogu tačno u trenutku kada koračа napred. Tajming je SVE!

en.q: What is De-ashi-barai?
opts: Sweeping the advancing foot at the precise moment it leaves the ground
Inner leg reap where Tori's leg reaps from the inside outward
Hip throw where Uke rotates over Tori's hip to the mat
Shoulder throw where Uke passes over Tori's shoulders and falls
en.exp: De-ashi-barai ('advancing foot sweep') – we sweep Uke's foot at the exact moment they step forward. Timing is EVERYTHING!

de.q: Was ist De-ashi-barai?
opts: Vorwärtsschritt-Fußsweep
Innere Fußfege
Äußere Hüfte
Schulterabwurf
de.exp: De-ashi-barai – Tori fegt Ukes Fuß genau beim Schritt vorwärts. Reines Timing.

fr.q: Qu'est-ce que De-ashi-barai?
opts: Balayage du pied avançant
Fauchage intérieur
Hanche extérieure
Projection d'épaule
fr.exp: De-ashi-barai – Tori balaie le pied d'Uke exactement au moment où il avance. Technique de timing pur.

es.q: ¿Qué es De-ashi-barai?
opts: Barrido del pie adelantado
Barrido interior de pie
Cadera exterior
Proyección de hombro
es.exp: De-ashi-barai – Tori barre el pie de Uke exactamente cuando da un paso adelante. Técnica de timing puro.

it.q: Cos'è De-ashi-barai?
opts: Spazzata del piede in avanzamento
Falcio interno del piede
Anca esterna
Proiezione di spalla
it.exp: De-ashi-barai – Tori spazza il piede di Uke esattamente nel momento in cui avanza. Tecnica di puro timing.

pt.q: O que é De-ashi-barai?
opts: Varrida do pé avançando
Ceifada interna do pé
Quadril externo
Projeção de ombro
pt.exp: De-ashi-barai – Tori varre o pé de Uke exatamente no momento em que avança. Técnica de timing puro.

ru.q: В чём разница между Рандори и Сиай?

Обе техники полностью одинаковы
Сиай для новичков
Рандори по другим правилам
ru.exp: Рандори = совместный спарринг без результата. Сиай = соревнование с результатом, лимитом времени и арбитром.

en.q: What is 'Gyaku-juji-jime'?

A straight frontal choke applied directly without crossing hands
A lapel choke where one hand grips deep inside the collar
A choke applied using pressure on the shoulder area instead

Bacanje isključivo kukom bez upotrebe ruku za silu

A throwing technique executed from a low kneeling position

sr.q: Šta je 'Bushido' i kakve veze ima sa džudoom?
opts: Samurajski kodeks koji je direktni duhovni predak džudo vrednosti
Poseban stil džudoa koji se razlikuje od Kodokan džudoa
Japanski ritualni ples koji se izvodi pre važnih borbi
Termin iz japanske arhitekture bez veze sa džudoom
sr.exp: Bushido ('put ratnika') je drevni samurajski moralni kodeks. Kano je svesno utkao Bushido vrednosti u džudo etiku – hrabrost, čast, lojalnost.

en.q: What is 'Bushido' and what connection does it have with judo?
opts: The samurai code – the direct spiritual ancestor of judo's core values
A distinct style of judo practised differently from Kodokan judo
A Japanese ritual dance performed before important contests
A term from Japanese architecture with no relation to judo
en.exp: Bushido ('way of the warrior') is the ancient samurai moral code. Kano consciously wove Bushido values – courage, honour, loyalty – into judo ethics.

de.q: Was ist Hane-goshi?
opts: Federnder Hüftwurf
Fegender Hüftwurf
Hüftrad – Tori rotiert Uke ausschließlich über die Hüfte
Innerer Oberschenkelwurf
de.exp: Hane-goshi – Tori federt Uke mit Ober- und Hüftaktion in die Luft, kombiniert mit Vorwärtsrotation.

fr.q: Qu'est-ce que Hane-goshi?
opts: Projection de hanche élastique
Projection de hanche par fauchage
Roue de hanche
Projection par cuisse intérieure
fr.exp: Hane-goshi – Tori propulse Uke en l'air avec une action de cuisse et de hanche, combinée avec une rotation vers l'avant.

sr.q: Tvoj protivnik je mnogo jači od tebe. Koji džudo princip ti govori šta da radiš?
opts: Ju yoku go o seisu – principom mekoće savlađuje se tvrda sila
Napadaj direktno frontalno koristeći maksimalnu snagu
Povlači se i čekaj kraj vremena bez aktivnog napada
Traži od sudije pomoć ili intervenciju u borbi
sr.exp: 'Ju yoku go o seisu' – mekoće savlađuje tvrdo. Ne suprotstavljaj se sili direktno – preusmer je, iskoristi je. To je džudo!

en.q: Your opponent is much stronger than you. Which judo principle guides you?
opts: Ju yoku go o seisu – the principle that softness overcomes hard force
Attack directly using maximum physical power and aggression
Retreat passively and wait for the clock to run down
Request assistance or intervention from the contest referee
en.exp: 'Ju yoku go o seisu' – softness overcomes hardness. Don't resist force directly – redirect it and use it. That is judo!

sr.q: Na takmičenju pobijeđaš 0-0 sa Shido-om protivnika. Šta je pametna taktika?
opts: Brani prednost ali ostani aktivan da ne dobiješ Shido kaznu
Idi u potpuno pasivnu odbranu i čekaj kraj vremena
Odmah svim snagama napadaj bez taktičke procene
Tražiš pauzu od sudije da odmoriš između napada
sr.exp: Sa jednim Shido prednosti treba balansirati aktivnu odbranu i povremene napade da ne dobiješ i sam Shido. Džudo IQ!

en.q: In a contest you are winning 0-0 thanks to your opponent's Shido. What is the smart tactic?
opts: Defend your lead but stay active enough to avoid receiving a Shido
Drop into complete passive defence and simply wait for time
Attack with maximum aggression immediately without tactical assessment
Request a time-out from the referee to rest between attacks
en.exp: With a one-Shido lead, balance active defence with occasional attacks so you don't earn a Shido yourself. That's judo IQ!

de.q: Du gewinnst 0:0 durch Shido des Gegners. Klügste Taktik?
opts: Aktiv bleiben, Position verteidigen, eigene Shido vermeiden
Vollständig passiv werden
Sofort angreifen
Timeout beantragen
de.exp: Mit Shido-Vorteil: aktiv und taktisch bleiben. Zu passive Verteidigung bringt eigenes Shido.

fr.q: Tu gagnes 0-0 grâce au Shido de l'adversaire. Meilleure tactique?
opts: Rester actif, défendre sa position, éviter son propre Shido
Devenir totalement passif
Attaquer immédiatement
Demander un temps mort
fr.exp: Avec l'avantage Shido: rester actif et tactique. Une défense trop passive amène son propre Shido.

es.q: Ganas 0-0 gracias al Shido del adversario. ¿Táctica más inteligente?
opts: Mantenerse activo, defender la posición, evitar el propio Shido
Volverse totalmente pasivo
Atacar de inmediato
Pedir un tiempo muerto
es.exp: Con ventaja de Shido: mantenerse activo y táctico. Una defensa demasiado pasiva conlleva el propio Shido.

it.q: Vinci 0-0 grazie allo Shido dell'avversario. Tattica più intelligente?
opts: Rimanere attivi, difendere la posizione, evitare il proprio Shido
Diventare completamente passivi
Attaccare immediatamente
Richiedere un time-out
it.exp: Con vantaggio Shido: rimanere attivi e tattici. Una difesa troppo passiva porta al proprio Shido.

pt.q: Você vence 0-0 pelo Shido do adversário. Tática mais inteligente?
opts: Manter-se ativo, defender a posição, evitar o próprio Shido
Tornar-se completamente passivo
Atacar imediatamente
Pedir tempo técnico
pt.exp: Com vantagem de Shido: manter-se ativo e tático. Uma defesa muito passiva gera o próprio Shido.

ru.q: Что такое Кани-басами и почему запрещён?
opts: Ножничный бросок — может сломать колено
Тип броска через бедро
Ножницы ногами для чёрного пояса
Запрещённый захват
ru.exp: Кани-басами = ножницы. Запрещён, так как может легко сломать колено. Прямое Хансоку-маке.

sr.q: Protivnik ti je viši i teži od tebe. Koje bacanje je najefikasnije?
opts: Ko-uchi-gari ili Seoi-nage – iskoristi svoju nižu visinu kao prednost
O-soto-gari direktno jer je noga bliža niskom borcu
Pokušaj Uchi-matu nagore ka višem protivniku direktno
Odmah prelazi u prizemnu borbu bez pokušaja bacanja
sr.exp: Manji džudoka treba da eksploatiše niži centar mase! Ko-uchi-gari, Seoi-nage i Morote-seoi su idealni jer koristiš proteivnikovu visinu i masu.

en.q: Your opponent is taller and heavier. Which throw is most effective?
opts: Ko-uchi-gari or Seoi-nage – use your lower centre of gravity as an advantage
O-soto-gari directly since the leg is closer to a shorter opponent
Try Uchi-mata driving upward toward the taller opponent
Transition immediately to groundwork without attempting any throw
en.exp: A smaller judoka should exploit a lower centre of mass! Ko-uchi-gari, Seoi-nage and Morote-seoi are ideal – you use their height and mass.

sr.q: Pokušao si Seoi-nage ali Uke se odbranio. Šta radiš odmah?
opts: Renzoku – odmah prebaci na Ko-uchi-gari ili O-soto-gari
Vrati se u neutralni stojeći stav i resetuj poziciju
Pusti hvat i tražiš novi hvat od samog početka
Pauziraj, odmori i sačekaj bolju situaciju
sr.exp: Renzoku-waza! Kad tehnika ne uspe, odmah kombinuješ. Uke je nestabilan od odbrane – to je savršen trenutak za drugu tehniku!

en.q: You attempted Seoi-nage but Uke defended. What do you do immediately?
opts: Renzoku – immediately switch to Ko-uchi-gari or O-soto-gari
Return to a neutral standing posture and reset completely
Release the grip and seek a new one from the very beginning
Pause the engagement and rest before trying again
en.exp: Renzoku-waza! When a technique fails, combine immediately. Uke is unbalanced from defending – the perfect moment for a second attack!

sr.q: Partner te moli da ga uhvatiš jako jako za revere. Zašto je to zapravo korisno za njega?
opts: Da vežba taisabaki i izbegavanje hvata bez korišćenja odela
To nije korisno jer džudo zahteva hvat odela
Da bi lakše ušao u bacanje bez ometanja odeće
Jer u situaciji ne nosi standardno džudo odelo kimono
sr.exp: Trening sa jakim grips partnera uči Taisabaki (kretanje tela) i Kuzushi otpornost. Tvrd trening = mekana borba!

en.q: Your partner asks you to grip their lapel as hard as possible. Why is that actually useful for them?
opts: To practise Taisabaki and grip-breaking
It isn't useful
So they can throw you more easily
Because their lapel is weak
en.exp: Training with a strong-gripping partner develops Taisabaki (body movement) and Kuzushi resistance. Hard training = smooth fighting!

sr.q: Šta znači 'Ippon' doslovno?
opts: Jedan bod/poen
Savršeno
Pobeda
Yuko – niži rezultat koji je ponovo uveden u važeća pravila
sr.exp: Ippon je maksimalni rezultat i donosi trenutnu pobedu. Može se postići kvalitetnim bacanjem na leđa, zadržavanjem od 20 sekundi ili predajom protivnika.

en.q: What does 'Ippon' literally mean?
opts: One point / score
Perfect
Victory
Yuko – a lower score used under the current rules
en.exp: Ippon is the maximum score and ends the contest immediately. It can be awarded for a high-quality throw onto the back, a 20-second hold or submission.

End

sr.q: Šta znači 'Sensei' doslovno?
opts: Džudoka koji je prošao taj isti put u džudou pre tebe
Trener ili učitelj koji prima novčanu nadoknadu za rad
Majstor borbe sa crnim pojasom višeg Dan stupnja
Stariji biološki brat ili sestra koji trenira džudo
sr.exp: Sen-sei = 'onaj koji je išao pre'. Titula poštovanja – ne samo znanje, već iskustvo i mudrost stečena ranije.

en.q: What does 'Sensei' literally mean?
opts: One who has already travelled further along this same path before you
A teacher or instructor who receives payment for their services
A master of fighting and combat techniques at the highest level
An older male sibling who also practises judo at the same club
en.exp: Sen-sei = 'one who went before'. A title of respect – not just knowledge, but experience and wisdom gained earlier.

sr.q: Šta znači 'Osae-komi-waza'?
opts: Tehnike pritiskanja i kontrole protivnika na podu tatamija
Tehnike bacanja protivnika iz stojećeg stava na tatami
Tehnike pritiska na vrat protivnika radi predaje
Tehnike pritiska na zglob protivnika za predaju
sr.exp: Osaekomi-waza = 'tehnike zaustavljanja i kontrole' – zadržavanja na podu. Osae = pritisni, komi = uđi/zadrži.

en.q: What does 'Osae-komi-waza' mean?
opts: Ground pressing and control techniques that hold the opponent pinned
Standing throwing techniques that send the opponent to the mat
Neck-pressure choking techniques that force submission on the ground
Joint lock techniques that apply damaging pressure to a joint
en.exp: Osaekomi-waza = 'techniques of stopping and holding' – ground pins. Osae = press, komi = enter/hold.

sr.q: Šta znači 'Toketa' kada to kaže sudija?
opts: Zadržavanje je raskinut/prekinut
Zadržavanje je prihvaćen
Pobeda
Početak
sr.exp: Toketa! = sudija tim označava da je zadržavanje prekinut i vreme prestaje da teče. Uke se uspeo osloboditi!

en.q: What does 'Toketa' mean when the referee says it?
opts: The hold is broken or released and the timed hold is ended immediately
The hold is accepted and the referee begins measuring the hold time
Declaration of victory for one competitor after an Ippon is scored
The referee's command for the judoka to begin or resume fighting
en.exp: Toketa! = the referee signals the hold-down is broken and the time stops counting. Uke has managed to escape!

de.q: Was bedeutet 'Toketa' wenn der Kampfrichter es sagt?
opts: Pin ist unterbrochen/gelöst
Pin ist akzeptiert
Sieg
Beginn
de.exp: Toketa! = der Kampfrichter signalisiert, dass der Haltegriff unterbrochen ist und die Zeit stoppt. Uke hat sich befreit!

fr.q: Que signifie 'Toketa' quand l'arbitre le dit?
opts: Le pin est rompu/libéré
Le pin est accepté
Victoire
Début
fr.exp: Toketa! = l'arbitre signale que l'immobilisation est rompue et le temps s'arrête. Uke a réussi à se libérer!

es.q: ¿Qué significa 'Toketa' cuando lo dice el árbitro?
opts: El pin está roto/liberado
El pin está aceptado
Victoria
Inicio
es.exp: Toketa! = el árbitro señala que la inmovilización está rota y el tiempo se detiene. ¡Uke ha logrado escapar!

it.q: Cosa significa 'Toketa' quando lo dice l'arbitro?
opts: Il pin è rotto/liberato
Il pin è accettato
Vittoria
Inizio
it.exp: Toketa! = l'arbitro segnala che l'immobilizzazione è interrotta e il tempo si ferma. Uke è riuscito a liberarsi!

pt.q: O que significa 'Toketa' quando o árbitro diz?
opts: O pin está quebrado/liberado
O pin está aceito
Vitória
Início
pt.exp: Toketa! = o árbitro sinaliza que a imobilização foi quebrada e o tempo para de contar. Uke conseguiu se libertar!

ru.q: Что означает 'Токэта' когда это произносит арбитр?
opts: Прижим прерван/освобождён
Прижим засчитан
Победа
Начало
ru.exp: Токэта! = арбитр сигнализирует, что удержание прервано и хронометраж останавливается. Укэ удалось освободиться!

sr.q: Šta je 'Joseki' u džudo dvorani?
opts: Počasna strana dvorane gde sede sensei, gosti i stariji učenici
Centralni deo tatamija gde se odvija borba
Prostorija za presvlačenje pre i posle džudo treninga
Ulaz u dvoranu kroz koji džudoke ulaze na trening
sr.exp: Joseki = 'počasno mesto' – strana dvorane okrenuta prema ulazu, gde sede sensei, gosti i diplome. Uvek joj se period klanja.

en.q: What is 'Joseki' in a judo hall?
opts: The place of honour in the dojo where Sensei and guests are seated
The central area of the Tatami where the main contest takes place
The changing room where judoka change into their training uniform
The entrance to the dojo through which judoka enter and exit
en.exp: Joseki = 'place of honour' – the side of the hall facing the entrance, where Sensei, guests and certificates are placed. Always bow toward it. Note: in competition judo, 'Joseki judges' is a separate term for the video review panel – not to be confused!

Be the largest and most physically imposing competitor possible
Train every single day without rest, recovery or planned breaks

Forma kata sa precizno propisanim redosledom pokreta

A ground exercise focused on improving ne-waza positions
A prescribed form with a fixed sequence of judo movements

sr.q: Koliko belih i crvenih zona ima standardni džudo tatami?

Tatami se sastoji samo od jedne bele zone borbe
Tatami ima dve zone identičnih boja bez razlike

opts: Contest area plus a safety zone and an outer zone around the mat
The tatami consists of only a single white contest zone
The tatami has two zones of identical colour without distinction
The tatami has no separately marked contest or safety zones

Contests are filmed exclusively for broadcast and media purposes
The coach has the right to formally request video footage of the match
A system for analysing individual technical performance in training

sr.q: Tvoj Sensei ti kaže 'Shikata ga nai'. Šta to znači i kako reaguješ?
opts: Prihvataš situaciju mirno i nastavljaš bez žalbi ili otpora
Žališ se direktno treneru na nepravičnu situaciju
Napuštaš trening umesto da nastaviš u toj situaciji
Iznova pitaš za detaljnije objašnjenje šta se desilo
sr.exp: 'Shikata ga nai' = 'ne može se ništa učiniti, tako je' – japonska filozofija prihvatanja. Džudoka to prima mirno i nastavlja. Nema vremena za žaljenje!

en.q: Your Sensei says 'Shikata ga nai'. What does it mean and how do you react?
opts: Accept the situation calmly and carry on without complaint or resistance
Complain directly to the coach about the unfair situation
Leave the training session rather than continue in that situation
Ask repeatedly for a more detailed explanation of what happened
en.exp: 'Shikata ga nai' = 'it cannot be helped, that is how it is' – a Japanese philosophy of acceptance. A judoka receives it calmly and moves on. No time for regret!

en.q: Why do we bow to our opponent in a judo contest?

Because bowing is strictly required by the judo rulebook
Because bowing earns additional sportsmanship points in competition
So that the referee and spectators can observe good sportsmanship

sr.q: Šta je 'Ashi-waza'?

Odbrambene technike koristenjem nogu u džudo borbi
sr.exp: Ashi-waza = tehnika nogama! Uključuje De-ashi-barai, Ko-uchi-gari, O-uchi-gari, Ko-soto-gari, O-soto-gari... Najčešće tehnike u modernom džudou!

en.q: What is 'Ashi-waza'?
opts: Standing foot and leg techniques including reaps, sweeps and blocks
All judo techniques performed with the legs while on the ground
Sacrifice throwing techniques where Tori falls using leg movements
Defensive techniques using the legs to block an opponent's attack

Kyu i Dan označavaju isti sistem bez razlike
Kyu označava crni, a Dan označava beli pojas
Dan važi za mlade, a Kyu za starije džudoke
sr.exp: Kyu = beli do braon pojas (obrnuto numerisano, 6. kyu = beli, 1. kyu = braon). Dan = crni pojas nadalje (1. dan do 10. dan).

en.q: What is 'Kyu' and what is 'Dan' in the belt system?
opts: Kyu = grades below the black belt, Dan = degrees of the black belt
Kyu and Dan are simply two different names for identical things
Kyu designates the black belt while Dan designates the white belt
Dan applies to young judoka while Kyu applies to older ones
en.exp: Kyu = white to brown belt (numbered in reverse: 6th Kyu = white, 1st Kyu = brown). Dan = black belt onwards (1st Dan to 10th Dan).

sr.q: Koliko boja pojaseva postoji u standardnom džudou za decu?
opts: 6-7 pojaseva: beli, žuti, narandžasti, zeleni, plavi, braon, crni
Samo 3 pojasa: beli, žuti i crni u svim klubovima
10 ili više različitih boja pojaseva u džudou
Samo beli i crni pojas se koriste u džudou
sr.exp: Tipičan sistem za mlade: Beli → Žuti → Narandžasti → Zeleni → Plavi → Braon → Crni. Svaki zahteva znanje tehnika i minimum treninga!

en.q: How many belt colours are there in standard judo for children?
opts: 6–7 belts: white, yellow, orange, green, blue, brown and black
Only 3 belts exist: white, yellow and black in all clubs
10 or more different belt colours are used in judo worldwide
Only white and black belts are used across all judo clubs
en.exp: Typical junior system: White → Yellow → Orange → Green → Blue → Brown → Black. Each requires knowledge of techniques and a minimum training period!

sr.q: Šta je Kani-basami i zašto je zabranjen na takmičenjima?
opts: Škarice nogama – zabranjen jer može slomiti koleno
Vrsta hvata – zabranjem zbog grubosti
Nožna poluga – dozvoljena od braon pojasa
Žrtveno bacanje – zabranjem zbog pada
sr.exp: Kani-basami (hvat škaricama) = napadamo Uke-ove noge sa dve noge kao škaricama. Zabranjen jer lako lomi koleno! Direktan Hansoku-make.

en.q: What is Kani-basami and why is it banned in competition?
opts: Scissors throw – banned because it can break the knee
A type of grip – banned for roughness
Leg lock – permitted from brown belt
Sacrifice throw – banned because of the fall
en.exp: Kani-basami (scissors throw) = Tori's legs scissors around one of Uke's legs – one in front, one behind. Banned because it easily breaks the knee! Direct Hansoku-make.

de.q: Was ist Sumi-otoshi?
opts: Eckenwurf (diagonaler Gleichgewichtsbruch)
Schulteropferwurf
Hüftwurf
Beinwurf
de.exp: Sumi-otoshi – Tori bricht Ukes Gleichgewicht diagonal und zieht ihn durch diagonalen Zug zu Boden.

fr.q: Qu'est-ce que Sumi-otoshi?
opts: Chute de coin (déséquilibre diagonal)
Projection d'épaule sacrifice
Projection de hanche
Projection de jambe
fr.exp: Sumi-otoshi – Tori déséquilibre Uke diagonalement et le tire à terre par une traction diagonale.

es.q: ¿Qué es Sumi-otoshi?
opts: Caída de esquina (desequilibrio diagonal)
Proyección de hombro de sacrificio
Proyección de cadera
Proyección de pierna
es.exp: Sumi-otoshi – Tori desequilibra a Uke diagonalmente y lo arrastra al suelo con una tracción diagonal.

it.q: Cos'è Sumi-otoshi?
opts: Caduta d'angolo (squilibrio diagonale)
Proiezione di spalla di sacrificio
Proiezione di anca
Proiezione di gamba
it.exp: Sumi-otoshi – Tori squilibra Uke in diagonale e lo trascina a terra con una trazione diagonale.

pt.q: O que é Sumi-otoshi?
opts: Queda de canto (desequilíbrio diagonal)
Projeção de ombro de sacrifício
Projeção de quadril
Projeção de perna
pt.exp: Sumi-otoshi – Tori desequilibra Uke diagonalmente e o arrasta ao chão com uma tração diagonal.

ru.q: Что такое Суми-отоши?
opts: Угловая подножка (диагональное нарушение равновесия)
Жертвенный бросок через плечо
Бросок через бедро
Бросок через ногу
ru.exp: Суми-отоши — Тори нарушает равновесие Укэ по диагонали и тянет его на татами диагональной тягой.

sr.q: Šta je 'Sono-mama'?
opts: Zamrzni – komanda da oba borca ostanu nepomični
Komanda sudije da borba odmah nastavi iz iste pozicije
Proglašenje pobednika nakon postignutog ippona
Shido kazna za pasivnost ili kršenje pravila borbe
sr.exp: Sono-mama = 'ostani kako jesi' – sudija zamrzava poziciju, obično da interveniše ili proveri nešto. Nakon toga 'Yoshi!' za nastavak.

en.q: What is 'Sono-mama'?
opts: Freeze – the referee's command for both judoka to remain completely still
The referee's command for the contest to immediately resume
The declaration of a winner following an achieved Ippon
A penalty awarded for passivity or rule infringement
en.exp: Sono-mama = 'stay as you are' – the referee freezes the position, usually to intervene or check something. Followed by 'Yoshi!' to resume.

de.q: Was ist 'Sono-mama'?
opts: Einfrieren – Kommando des Kampfrichters, damit beide Judoka stillstehen
Kommando des Kampfrichters, den Kampf sofort fortzusetzen
Ausrufung des Siegers nach einem erzielten Ippon
Strafe für Passivität oder Regelverstoß beim Wettkampf
de.exp: Sono-mama = 'bleib wie du bist' – der Kampfrichter friert die Position ein, um einzugreifen oder etwas zu prüfen. Danach 'Yoshi!' zum Fortfahren.

sr.q: Šta je razlika između 'Nage' i 'Katame' waza?
opts: Nage su stojeća bacanja, Katame su parterne kontrolne tehnike
Nage i Katame su oba različita naziva za iste tehnike bacanja
Nage označava napadačke, a Katame odbrambene džudo tehnike
Nage i Katame nemaju suštinsku tehničku razliku
sr.exp: Nage-waza = sve tehnike bacanja (stojeće i žrtvene). Katame-waza = sve tehnike na podu (zadržavanja + poluge + gušenja). Dva osnovna stuba džudoa!

en.q: What is the difference between 'Nage' and 'Katame' waza?
opts: Nage = standing throws, Katame = ground control techniques
Both Nage and Katame are different names for throwing
Nage refers to attacking and Katame to defensive techniques
Nage and Katame have no meaningful technical distinction
en.exp: Nage-waza = all throwing techniques (standing and sacrifice). Katame-waza = all ground techniques (pins + joint locks + chokes). The two main pillars of judo!

de.q: Was bedeutet 'Waza'?
opts: Technik/Fähigkeit
Wettkampf
Training
Gürtelniveau
de.exp: 'Waza' = Technik oder Fähigkeit. Nage-waza, Katame-waza, Tokui-waza.

fr.q: Que signifie 'Waza'?
opts: Technique/compétence
Compétition
Entraînement
Niveau de ceinture
fr.exp: 'Waza' = technique ou compétence. Nage-waza, Katame-waza, Tokui-waza.

es.q: ¿Qué significa 'Waza'?
opts: Técnica/habilidad
Competición
Entrenamiento
Nivel de cinturón
es.exp: 'Waza' = técnica o habilidad. Nage-waza, Katame-waza, Tokui-waza.

it.q: Cosa significa 'Waza'?
opts: Tecnica/abilità
Gara
Allenamento
Livello di cintura
it.exp: 'Waza' = tecnica o abilità. Nage-waza, Katame-waza, Tokui-waza.

pt.q: O que significa 'Waza'?
opts: Técnica/habilidade
Competição
Treino
Nível de faixa
pt.exp: 'Waza' = técnica ou habilidade. Nage-waza, Katame-waza, Tokui-waza.

ru.q: Что означает 'Вадза'?
opts: Техника/умение
Соревнование
Тренировка
Уровень пояса
ru.exp: 'Вадза' = техника или умение. Нагэ-вадза, Катамэ-вадза, Токуи-вадза.

sr.q: Kada koristimo Tai-otoshi?
opts: Kad protivnik korača napred – blokiraj nogu i iskoristi trenutak
Kad god je protivnik dovoljno blizu tvog tela
Isključivo kada se boriš sa lakšim i slabijim protivnikom
Kao direktna priprema za prelaz na prizemnu borbu
sr.exp: Tai-otoshi ('pad tela') = bacanje blokadom noge + rotacijom tela.Ključno: koristimo Uke-ov korak napred. Tajming je sve!

en.q: When do we use Tai-otoshi?
opts: When the opponent steps forward – block their leg and use the momentum
Whenever the opponent is close enough to your body
Exclusively when you are competing against a lighter opponent
As direct preparation before transitioning to ground fighting
en.exp: Tai-otoshi ('body drop') = throw by blocking the leg and rotating the body. Key: exploit Uke's forward step. Timing is everything!

de.q: Was schlägt beim Yoko-ukemi auf die Matte?
opts: Arm (Handfläche + ganzer Arm) und Außenseite des Beins
Nur der Arm schlägt alleine auf die Matte
Die Schulter schlägt zuerst auf die Matte auf
Nur Rücken und Arme schlagen gleichzeitig auf
de.exp: Yoko-ukemi: ganzer Arm (Handfläche bis Oberarm) schlägt flach auf die Matte. Außenbein landet daneben.

fr.q: Quelles parties du corps frappent le tatami lors de Yoko-ukemi?
opts: Bras (paume + tout le bras) et côté extérieur de la jambe
Bras seulement
Épaule
Dos et bras
fr.exp: Yoko-ukemi: tout le bras (paume, avant-bras, bras) frappe à plat sur le tatami. La jambe extérieure atterrit à côté.

es.q: ¿Qué partes del cuerpo golpean el tatami en Yoko-ukemi?
opts: Brazo (palma + todo el brazo) y lado exterior de la pierna
Solo el brazo
Hombro
Espalda y brazos
es.exp: Yoko-ukemi: todo el brazo (palma, antebrazo, bíceps) golpea plano el tatami. La pierna exterior aterriza al lado.

it.q: Quali parti del corpo colpiscono il tatami in Yoko-ukemi?
opts: Braccio (palmo + tutto il braccio) e lato esterno della gamba
Solo il braccio
Spalla
Schiena e braccia
it.exp: Yoko-ukemi: tutto il braccio (palmo, avambraccio, bicipite) batte piatto sul tatami. La gamba esterna atterra di lato.

pt.q: Quais partes do corpo batem no tatami em Yoko-ukemi?
opts: Braço (palma + todo o braço) e lado externo da perna
Só o braço
Ombro
Costas e braços
pt.exp: Yoko-ukemi: todo o braço (palma, antebraço, bíceps) bate plano no tatami. A perna externa pousa ao lado.

ru.q: Какие части тела хлопают по татами при Ёко-укэми?
opts: Рука (ладонь + вся рука) и внешняя сторона ноги
Только рука
Плечо
Спина и руки
ru.exp: Ёко-укэми: вся рука (ладонь, предплечье, плечо) хлопает плашмя по татами. Внешняя нога приземляется рядом.

sr.q: Šta je 'Shugyo' u džudo kontekstu?
opts: Intenzivna disciplinovana vežba radi duhovnog samousavršavanja
Posebna vrsta kata forme za napredne crne pojaseve
Svečana ceremonija dobijanja novog pojasa u dojou
Formalno takmičenje sa sudijama i bodovanjem
sr.exp: Shugyo = 'rigorizovana praksa samousavršavanja'. U džudou to znači svakodnevni naporni trening koji oblikuje karakter – ne samo telo.

en.q: What is 'Shugyo' in the judo context?
opts: Intense and disciplined practice focused on spiritual self-improvement
A prescribed kata form performed by advanced black belt judoka
A formal ceremony for the awarding of a new judo belt
A formal competition with referees, scoring and time limits
en.exp: Shugyo = 'rigorous practice of self-mastery'. In judo it means daily demanding training that builds character – not just the body.

sr.q: Šta je IJF (International Judo Federation)?
opts: Međunarodna džudo federacija – krovni organ džudoa osnovan 1951.
Nacionalna japanska džudo federacija za domaći sport
Specijalni olimpijski komitet isključivo za džudo sport
Akademski institut posvećen proučavanju džudo filozofije
sr.exp: IJF (Int. Judo Federation) osnovan 1951. – reguliše svetska pravila, takmičenja, IJF World Ranking i Olimpijsku selekciju.

en.q: What is the IJF (International Judo Federation)?
opts: The international governing body of judo worldwide – established in 1951
The national federation governing judo within Japan domestically
A specialised Olympic committee dedicated exclusively to judo
An academic institute devoted to the study of judo philosophy
en.exp: IJF (International Judo Federation) founded in 1951 – regulates world rules, competitions, the IJF World Ranking and Olympic selection.

Sve parterne tehnike

10 Sekunden
30 Sekunden
15 Sekunden

Zadržavanje je potvrđen i sudija počinje meriti vreme trajanja
Proglašena pobeda jednog od boraca ipponom u borbi
Komanda sudije za početak nove džudo borbe

The hold is confirmed and the referee starts measuring hold time
Declaration of victory awarded to one competitor in the match
The referee's command to begin or restart the judo contest
en.exp: Toketa! = 'broken'. The referee calls this when Uke successfully escapes a pin. Timing stops immediately.

sr.q: Koji stav je zabranjen u modernom džudou (od 2010)?
opts: Direktno hvatanje nogu bez prethodnog hvata gornjeg tela
Hvatanje ovratnika kao prvi kontakt u borbi
Blokada napred ispruženim nogama iz stojećeg stava
Hvat za rukav bez kontakta s drugom rukom
sr.exp: Direktno hvatanje nogu (Kani-basami, Ashi-garami stojeći i sl.) je zabranjeno. Direktan Hansoku-make! IJF pravila 2010+.

en.q: Which stance has been banned in modern judo (since 2010)?
opts: Grabbing both legs directly without first establishing an upper-body grip
Gripping the opponent's collar as the opening contact in a match
Blocking the opponent's advancing leg while standing upright
Gripping only the sleeve without establishing a second-hand grip
en.exp: Directly grabbing the legs (Kani-basami, standing Ashi-garami, etc.) is forbidden. Direct Hansoku-make! IJF rules 2010+.

Art des Hüftwurfs – zu stark
Beinschere für Schwarzgurt
Verbotener Gi-Griff

fr.q: Qu'est-ce que Kani-basami et pourquoi est-il interdit?

Ciseaux de jambes pour ceinture noire
Prise interdite

Tijeras de piernas para cinturón negro
Agarre prohibido

Presa proibita

Pegada proibida

sr.q: Koliko Shido kazni vodi do automatskog poraza?
opts: 3 Shido = Hansoku-make
2 Shido
4 Shido
1 direktni Shido

opts: 3 Shido = Hansoku-make
2 Shido
4 Shido
1 direct Shido

Halten
Würgen
Hebeln

Étrangler
Appliquer une clé

opts: Proyectar
Mantener
Estrangular
Aplicar palanca

it.q: Cosa significa 'Nage' (es. Seoi-nage)?

Mantenere
Strangolare
Applicare leva

Estrangular
Aplicar chave

opts: Бросать
Удерживать
Душить
Применять болевой

sr.q: Da li se dva Waza-ari sumiraju u Ippon?
opts: Da – dva Waza-ari = Ippon (pobeda)
Ne – ostaju kao dva pola-poena
Samo u nekim kategorijama
Zavisi od sudije
sr.exp: Da! Dva Waza-ari = Ippon. Staro pravilo 'Waza-ari awasete Ippon' je vraćeno u IJF pravilnik. Svaki Waza-ari vredi!

en.q: Do two Waza-ari add up to Ippon?
opts: Yes – two Waza-ari = Ippon (victory)
No – they remain as two half-points
Only in certain categories
Depends on the referee
en.exp: Yes! Two Waza-ari = Ippon. The old rule 'Waza-ari awasete Ippon' has been restored in the IJF rulebook. Every Waza-ari counts!

de.q: Was ist Waza-ari?
opts: Halber Punkt – zwei ergeben Ippon
Voller Punkt
Strafe
Zeitbonus
de.exp: Waza-ari = 'fast Ippon'. Zwei Waza-ari = Ippon (automatischer Sieg).

fr.q: Qu'est-ce que le Waza-ari?
opts: Demi-point – deux donnent un Ippon
Point entier
Une pénalité pour comportement négatif
Bonus de temps
fr.exp: Waza-ari = 'presque Ippon'. Deux Waza-ari = Ippon (victoire automatique).

es.q: ¿Qué significa 'Guruma' (p. ej. Harai-goshi)?
opts: Rueda – proyección rotatoria
Segar
Levantar directamente al adversario
Empujar
es.exp: 'Guruma' = rueda. La proyección hace girar a Uke como una rueda alrededor del cuerpo o la pierna de Tori.

it.q: Cosa significa 'Guruma' (es. Harai-goshi)?
opts: Ruota – proiezione rotatoria
Falciare
Sollevare l'avversario direttamente senza tecnica
Spingere
it.exp: 'Guruma' = ruota. La proiezione fa girare Uke come una ruota attorno al corpo o alla gamba di Tori.

pt.q: O que significa 'Guruma' (ex. Harai-goshi)?
opts: Roda – projeção rotatória
Ceifar
Erguer o adversário diretamente sem técnica
Empurrar
pt.exp: 'Guruma' = roda. A projeção faz Uke girar como uma roda ao redor do corpo ou da perna de Tori.

ru.q: Что такое Ваза-ари?

Целый балл
Штраф
Временной бонус
ru.exp: Ваза-ари = 'почти Иппон'. Два Ваза-ари = Иппон (автоматическая победа).

sr.q: Šta je 'Golden Score' period?
opts: Produžetak bez limita – prva prednost donosi pobedu
Bonus period od tačno 3 minuta sa normalnim bodovanjem
Period u kom se jedino Ippon računa kao rezultat
Specijalni krug sa novim parovima boraca
sr.exp: Golden Score = produžetak bez vremenskog ograničenja. Borba se nastavlja dok jedan takmičar ne postigne Ippon, Waza-ari ili Shido protivnik.

en.q: What is the 'Golden Score' period?
opts: Unlimited overtime where the first judoka to score any advantage wins
A fixed bonus period of exactly 3 minutes with normal scoring rules
A special period in which only Ippon counts as a scoring action
A special additional round in which new pairings are created
en.exp: Golden Score = unlimited overtime. The contest continues until one competitor scores Ippon, Waza-ari, or their opponent receives a Shido.

de.q: Was ist Golden Score in der Praxis?
opts: Unbegrenzte Verlängerung – erste Wertung oder Shido entscheidet
Eine zusätzliche Verlängerung von genau 5 Minuten
Nur Ippon zählt
Im Golden Score sind besondere sonst verbotene Techniken erlaubt
de.exp: Golden Score: läuft unbegrenzt. Erste Wertung (Ippon/Waza-ari) oder Shido des Gegners beendet Kampf.

fr.q: Qu'est-ce que le Golden Score en pratique?
opts: Prolongation illimitée – premier score ou Shido décide
5 minutes supplémentaires
Seul l'Ippon compte
Techniques spéciales autorisées
fr.exp: Golden Score: durée illimitée. Premier score (Ippon/Waza-ari) ou Shido de l'adversaire termine le combat.

es.q: ¿Qué es el Golden Score en la práctica?
opts: Prórroga ilimitada – primer punto o Shido decide
5 minutos extra
Solo cuenta el Ippon
Técnicas especiales permitidas
es.exp: Golden Score: duración ilimitada. Primer punto (Ippon/Waza-ari) o Shido del adversario termina el combate.

it.q: Cos'è il Golden Score in pratica?
opts: Proroga illimitata – primo punto o Shido decide
5 minuti extra
Conta solo l'Ippon
Tecniche speciali permesse
it.exp: Golden Score: durata illimitata. Primo punto (Ippon/Waza-ari) o Shido dell'avversario termina il combattimento.

pt.q: O que é Golden Score na prática?
opts: Prorrogação ilimitada – primeiro ponto ou Shido decide
5 minutos extras
Só conta o Ippon
Técnicas especiais permitidas
pt.exp: Golden Score: duração ilimitada. Primeiro ponto (Ippon/Waza-ari) ou Shido do adversário termina o combate.

ru.q: Что означает 'Вадза'?

Соревнование
Тренировка
Уровень пояса

Sudija Shushin samostalnim gestom prema video ekranu

sr.q: Šta znači 'Ju' u 'Ju no ri' principu?
opts: Mekoća, popuštanje i fleksibilnost – jezgro džudo principa
Direktna fizička snaga i sila kao osnova džudo borbe
Brzina kretanja i reakcije kao jedini faktor pobede
Tehničko znanje i preciznost bez obraćanja pažnje na silu
sr.exp: Ju = mekoća, fleksibilnost, popuštanje. 'Ju no ri' = princip mekoće. Umesto da se suprotstaviš sili, prepustiš joj se i preusmeriš je.

en.q: What does 'Ju' mean in the principle 'Ju no ri'?
opts: Softness, yielding and flexibility – the core principle of judo
Direct physical strength and force as the basis of judo
Maximum speed of movement and reaction as the decisive factor
Technical precision and knowledge without reliance on physical force
en.exp: Ju = softness, yielding, flexibility. 'Ju no ri' = the principle of softness. Rather than resisting force, you yield to it and redirect it.

Because bowing is the accepted gesture when you have lost
To demonstrate to referees and spectators that we are more exhausted
en.exp: Bowing after the contest is sincere gratitude. Our opponent gave their energy and knowledge by fighting us. That deserves deep respect.

sr.q: Šta je 'Mushin' u kontekstu džudoa?
opts: Stanje uma bez misli – čista prisutnost i čisto instinktivno reagovanje
Posebna vrsta uchi-komi vežbe za napredne džudoke
Mentalna priprema koja se radi neposredno pred takmičenje
Specifična meditacija koja se praktikuje posle svakog treninga
sr.exp: Mushin (mu=praznina, shin=um) = um bez misli. U ovom stanju džudoka reaguje instinktivno, bez svesne analize. Cilj naprednog treninga.

en.q: What is 'Mushin' in the judo context?
opts: A state of mind without thought – pure presence and instinctive reaction
A specific type of Uchi-komi drill practised by advanced judoka
A mental preparation protocol performed right before competition
A specific meditation practice conducted after every training session
en.exp: Mushin (mu = emptiness, shin = mind) = mind without thought. In this state the judoka reacts instinctively, without conscious analysis. The goal of advanced training.

Tehnika nije krajnji cilj – jedino bacanje protivnika jeste

en.q: What does 'judo is a path, not a destination' mean in judo philosophy?
opts: Judo is a continuous journey of personal growth and never a final destination
The technique itself is irrelevant – only the throw matters
Competition has no real place or importance in judo practice
The belt is purely decorative and carries no real meaning
en.exp: Kano said: the 'Do' in judo means a path that never ends. Every training session is a step, but perfection is never reached. You learn for ever.

The technique itself is irrelevant – only the throw matters
Competition has no real place or importance in judo practice
The belt is purely decorative and carries no real meaning
ru.exp: Kano said: the 'Do' in judo means a path that never ends. Every training session is a step, but perfection is never reached. You learn for ever.

sr.q: Šta je 'Fudoshin' i kako se primenjuje u borbi?
opts: Nepokolebljivi um – strah ni uzbuđenje ne utiču na borčeve reakcije
Fizička tehnika za bolju ravnotežu u stojećem stavu
Specijalni mentalni trening koji se radi samo pre takmičenja
Budističko duhovno iskustvo koje džudoke traže kroz meditaciju
sr.exp: Fudoshin = nepokolebljivi um. Ni pobeda ni poraz te ne poremete. U Fudoshin stanju boriš se jednako taktički u produžetku Golden Score kao u prvoj sekundi.

en.q: What is 'Fudoshin' and how is it applied in a contest?
opts: Immovable mind – neither fear nor excitement disrupts reactions
A physical technique for improving stability in the judo stance
A specific mental training protocol done before competitions
A Buddhist spiritual experience sought through judo meditation
en.exp: Fudoshin = immovable mind. Neither victory nor defeat disrupts you. In Fudoshin you fight as tactically in Golden Score as in the first second.

sr.q: Šta znači poslovica 'Uke soto ni hana, makoto uchi ni aru'?
opts: Forma je spolja, istinitost/karakter je iznutra
Tehnika se vidi, snaga se krije
Ukemi je spoljna tehnika, napad je unutrašnji
Uke je vani, Tori je unutra
sr.exp: Ovo govori da džudo nije samo fizička forma. Pravi karakter, integritet i iskrenost su unutrašnji kvaliteti koje džudo izgrađuje.

en.q: What does the saying 'Uke soto ni hana, makoto uchi ni aru' mean?
opts: Form is visible on the outside but truth and character live within
Only technique is visible to others while strength remains hidden
Ukemi is an external expression while the attack comes from within
Uke stands on the outside of the mat while Tori is on the inside
en.exp: This says that judo is not merely physical form. True character, integrity and sincerity are internal qualities that judo builds.

de.q: Was ist Te-guruma?
opts: Handrad – Tori hebt Uke an Oberschenkel und Nacken
Schulterrad – Tori rotiert Uke über die Schultern
Beinrad – Tori rotiert Uke über die gestreckten Beine
Hüftrad – Tori rotiert Uke ausschließlich über die Hüfte
de.exp: Te-guruma – Tori greift Ukes Oberschenkel und Nacken/Kragen und wirft in Radbewegung.

fr.q: Qu'est-ce que Te-guruma?
opts: Roue de main – Tori soulève Uke par la cuisse et le cou
Roue d'épaule – Tori fait passer Uke par-dessus ses épaules
Roue de jambe – Tori fait pivoter Uke sur la jambe tendue
Roue de hanche
fr.exp: Te-guruma – Tori saisit la cuisse et le cou/col d'Uke et le projette en mouvement de roue.

es.q: ¿Qué es Te-guruma?
opts: Rueda de mano – Tori eleva a Uke por el muslo y el cuello
Rueda de hombro – Tori hace pasar a Uke por sus hombros
Rueda de pierna – Tori hace girar a Uke sobre la pierna extendida
Rueda de cadera
es.exp: Te-guruma – Tori agarra el muslo y el cuello/cuello de Uke y lo proyecta en movimiento de rueda.

it.q: Cos'è Te-guruma?
opts: Ruota di mano – Tori solleva Uke per la coscia e il collo
Ruota di spalla – Tori fa passare Uke sopra le sue spalle
Ruota di gamba – Tori fa ruotare Uke sulla gamba tesa
Ruota d'anca
it.exp: Te-guruma – Tori afferra la coscia e il collo/collo di Uke e lo proietta in movimento di ruota.

pt.q: O que é Te-guruma?
opts: Roda de mão – Tori ergue Uke pela coxa e pescoço
Roda de ombro – Tori faz Uke passar pelos seus ombros
Roda de perna – Tori faz Uke girar sobre a perna estendida
Roda de quadril
pt.exp: Te-guruma – Tori agarra a coxa e o pescoço/colarinho de Uke e o projeta em movimento de roda.

ru.q: Что такое Тэ-гурума?
opts: Колесо руки — Тори поднимает Укэ за бедро и шею
Колесо плеча
Колесо ноги
Колесо бедра
ru.exp: Тэ-гурума — Тори захватывает бедро и шею/воротник Укэ и бросает движением колеса.

sr.q: Šta Kano misli pod 'maksimalnom efikasnošću' van tatamija?
opts: Primena principa optimalne efikasnosti na sva životna područja
Primena principa jedino u oblasti borilačkih veština
Metod bržeg i jačeg treniranja za bolje rezultate
Dijetetski princip manje jedenja i intenzivnijeg treniranja
sr.exp: Kano nije mislio samo na džudo! Seiryoku-zenyo = koristi energiju i um optimalno u poslu, učenju, porodici. Džudo kao filozofija života.

en.q: What does Kano mean by 'maximum efficiency' beyond the Tatami?
opts: Applying the principle of maximum efficiency to every area of life
Applying the principle only within the field of martial arts
A method of training faster and harder to achieve better results
A dietary principle of eating less and training more intensely
en.exp: Kano was not thinking of judo alone! Seiryoku-zenyo = use energy and mind optimally in work, study, family. Judo as a life philosophy.

sr.q: Šta je 'Randori no ri' – princip slobodne vežbe?
opts: Realna vežba gradi prilagodljivost i odlučivanje koje kata ne može
Randori je jedina prava borba, kata je zastarela
Kata je superiorni način treniranja od randorija
Slobodna vežba postoji samo radi zabave bez cilja
sr.exp: Kano je naglašavao balans kata (forme) i randori (slobodne vežbe). Kata uči principe, randori uči primenu u nepoznatim situacijama.

en.q: What is 'Randori no ri' – the principle of free practice?
opts: Real practice (Randori) builds adaptability and decision-making that Kata cannot develop
Randori is the only real form of contest in judo practice
Kata is a superior method of training compared to randori
Free practice exists purely for enjoyment with no learning goal
en.exp: Kano stressed the balance between Kata (forms) and Randori (free practice). Kata teaches principles; Randori teaches their application in unknown situations.

fr.q: Qu'est-ce que Sasae-tsurikomi-ashi?
opts: Projection de cheville appuyée-soulevée-tirée
Projection de pied intérieur
Projection de pied extérieur
Roue de pied
fr.exp: Sasae-tsurikomi-ashi – le pied appuie sur la cheville d'Uke, les bras tirent vers le haut et en rotation.

es.q: ¿Qué es Sasae-tsurikomi-ashi?
opts: Proyección de tobillo apoyada-elevada-tirada
Proyección interior de pie
Proyección exterior de pie
Rueda de pie
es.exp: Sasae-tsurikomi-ashi – el pie apoya el tobillo de Uke, los brazos tiran hacia arriba y giran.

it.q: Cos'è Sasae-tsurikomi-ashi?
opts: Proiezione di caviglia sostenuta-sollevata-tirata
Proiezione interna di piede
Proiezione esterna di piede
Ruota di piede
it.exp: Sasae-tsurikomi-ashi – il piede sostiene la caviglia di Uke, le braccia tirano verso l'alto e ruotano.

pt.q: O que é Sasae-tsurikomi-ashi?
opts: Projeção de tornozelo apoiada-elevada-puxada
Projeção interna de pé
Projeção externa de pé
Roda de pé
pt.exp: Sasae-tsurikomi-ashi – o pé apoia o tornozelo de Uke, os braços puxam para cima e giram.

ru.q: Что такое Сасаэ-цурикоми-аси?
opts: Опорно-поднимающий-тянущий бросок через голень
Внутренний бросок через стопу
Внешний бросок через стопу
Колесо стопы
ru.exp: Сасаэ-цурикоми-аси — стопа упирается в голень Укэ, руки тянут вверх и вращают.

Bacanje
Pobeda
Trening

Throw

Training

sr.q: Šta znači 'Kuzushi' doslovno?
opts: Porušiti i srušiti – japanski pojam za narušavanje ravnoteže
Baciti protivnika direktno bez prethodnog kuzushija
Uhvatiti odelo ili telo protivnika radi kontrole
Gurnuti protivnika direktno bez tehničke pripreme
sr.exp: Kuzushi dolazi od glagola 'kuzusu' = srušiti, porušiti. U džudou = narušiti Uke-ovu ravnotežu pre bacanja. Fundamentalni pojam.

en.q: What does 'Kuzushi' literally mean?
opts: To break or collapse – to disrupt the opponent's balance before a throw
To throw the opponent directly onto the mat without preparation
To grab the opponent's clothing or body to establish control
To push the opponent directly without using their own momentum
en.exp: Kuzushi comes from the verb 'kuzusu' = to collapse, to break down. In judo = disrupting Uke's balance before the throw. A fundamental concept.

de.q: What does 'Kuzushi' literally mean?

fr.q: Qu'est-ce que Ko-uchi-gari?
opts: Petit fauchage intérieur
Grand fauchage intérieur
Projection de hanche intérieure
Coup de pied
fr.exp: Ko-uchi-gari = petit fauchage précis à l'intérieur de la jambe d'Uke. Technique, timing et Kuzushi sont décisifs.

es.q: ¿Qué es Ko-uchi-gari?
opts: Pequeño barrido interior
Gran barrido interior
Proyección de cadera interior
Patada
es.exp: Ko-uchi-gari = pequeño barrido preciso en el interior de la pierna de Uke. Técnica, timing y Kuzushi son decisivos.

it.q: Cos'è Ko-uchi-gari?
opts: Piccolo falcio interno
Grande falcio interno
Proiezione di anca interna
Calcio
it.exp: Ko-uchi-gari = piccolo falcio preciso all'interno della gamba di Uke. Tecnica, timing e Kuzushi sono decisivi.

pt.q: O que é Ko-uchi-gari?
opts: Pequena ceifada interna
Grande ceifada interna
Projeção de quadril interno
Chute
pt.exp: Ko-uchi-gari = pequena ceifada precisa na parte interna da perna de Uke. Técnica, timing e Kuzushi são decisivos.

ru.q: Что такое Ко-учи-гари?
opts: Малая внутренняя подсечка
Большая внутренняя подсечка
Внутренний бросок через бедро
Удар ногой
ru.exp: Ко-учи-гари = небольшая точная подсечка по внутренней стороне ноги Укэ. Техника, тайминг и Кузуши решают.

sr.q: Šta znači 'Tsukuri' u kontekstu bacanja?
opts: Ulaz i priprema tela za bacanje
Finalno izvođenje bacanja
Narušavanje ravnoteže
Hvatanje hvata
sr.exp: Tsukuri = 'napraviti, pripremiti'. Drugi korak triade: Kuzushi → Tsukuri (ulaz, pozicioniranje) → Kake (izvođenje).

en.q: What does 'Tsukuri' mean in the context of a throw?
opts: Entry and full body preparation immediately before executing the throw
The explosive final execution phase when the opponent actually falls
Breaking the opponent's balance as the essential first step
The initial gripping of the opponent's clothing to establish control
en.exp: Tsukuri = 'to make, to prepare'. The second step of the triad: Kuzushi → Tsukuri (entry, positioning) → Kake (execution).

de.q: Was bedeutet 'Kake'?
opts: Wurfausführung
Gleichgewichtsbruch
Eintritt
Falltechnik
de.exp: Kake = Ausführung/Abschluss des Wurfs. Drittes Element nach Kuzushi und Tsukuri.

fr.q: Que signifie 'Kake'?
opts: Exécution de la projection
Déséquilibre sans technique préalable
Entrée
Technique de chute
fr.exp: Kake = exécution/achèvement de la projection. Troisième élément après Kuzushi et Tsukuri.

es.q: ¿Qué significa 'Kake'?
opts: Ejecución de la proyección
Ruptura del equilibrio
Entrada
Técnica de caída
es.exp: Kake = ejecución/conclusión de la proyección. Tercer elemento tras Kuzushi y Tsukuri.

it.q: Cosa significa 'Kake'?
opts: Esecuzione della proiezione
Rottura dell'equilibrio
Entrata
Tecnica di caduta
it.exp: Kake = esecuzione/completamento della proiezione. Terzo elemento dopo Kuzushi e Tsukuri.

Quebra do equilíbrio
Entrada
Técnica de queda
pt.exp: Kake = execução/conclusão da projeção. Terceiro elemento após Kuzushi e Tsukuri.

Priprema tela i pozicije pre ulaza u bacanje
Narušavanje ravnoteže protivnika kao prvi korak tehnike
Hvatanje odela i postavljanje hvata pre ulaza
sr.exp: Kake = 'zakačiti, izvesti'. Treći i finalni korak: Kuzushi → Tsukuri → Kake. Bez prvа dva, Kake ne može uspeti.

en.q: What does 'Kake' mean in the throwing triad?
opts: Execution – the explosive final phase of the throw when Uke falls
Preparation of the body and position before entering the throw
Breaking the opponent's balance as the essential first step
Establishing the grip on the opponent's clothing before entering
en.exp: Kake = 'to engage, to execute'. The third and final step: Kuzushi → Tsukuri → Kake. Without the first two, Kake cannot succeed.

Sala za borbu

sr.q: Šta znači 'Kansetsu'?
opts: Zglob – kansetsu-waza su tehnike pritiska na zglobove
Tehnika gušenja pritiskanjem vrata protivnika
Bacanje iz stojećeg stava na tatami
Kontrolisani pad koji se uči kao ukemi tehnika
sr.exp: Kansetsu = zglob (anatomski). Kansetsu-waza = tehnike poluga na zglobove, pretežno lakat. Zabranjeno za mlađe kategorije.

en.q: What does 'Kansetsu' mean?
opts: Joint – Kansetsu-waza are techniques applying pressure to joints
Neck pressure technique that forces submission in groundwork
Throwing technique that sends the opponent to the mat from standing
A controlled falling technique practised as ukemi training
en.exp: Kansetsu = joint (anatomical). Kansetsu-waza = joint lock techniques, primarily on the elbow. Forbidden for younger age categories.

de.q: Was ist Judos Rolle bei Persönlichkeitsentwicklung?
opts: Disziplin, Respekt, Ausdauer und Umgang mit Sieg und Niederlage
Nur körperliche Fitness
Wettkampfvorbereitung
Berufliche Qualifikation
de.exp: Kano entwarf Judo als Erziehungssystem: Körper, Geist und Charakter. 'Judo ist Weg zu Körper, Geist und Seele.'

fr.q: Quel est le rôle du judo dans le développement de la personnalité?

Seulement forme physique
Préparation compétition
Qualification professionnelle
fr.exp: Kano a conçu le judo comme système éducatif: corps, esprit et caractère. 'Le judo est la voie du corps, de l'esprit et de l'âme.'

Solo forma física
Preparación para la competición
Cualificación profesional

it.q: Qual è il ruolo del judo nello sviluppo della personalità?

Solo forma fisica
Preparazione alla gara
Qualificazione professionale

sr.q: Šta znači 'Shime' u shime-waza?
opts: Stezati, gušiti – shime-waza su tehnike pritiska na vrat
Pritisnuti telo protivnika na tatami zadržavanje tehnikama
Baciti protivnika na tatami iz stojećeg stava
Uhvatiti protivnika za vrat pri hvatu pojasa
sr.exp: Shime = stezati, gušiti. Shime-waza su tehnike gušenja koja pritiskaju karotidne arterije ili disajne puteve. Uke mora predati se tapkanjem!

en.q: What does 'Shime' mean in Shime-waza?
opts: To constrict or choke – Shime-waza are neck-pressure techniques
To press the opponent's body against the mat using a pin
To throw the opponent from a standing position onto the mat
To grip the opponent's throat directly with both hands
en.exp: Shime = to constrict, to choke. Shime-waza are techniques that compress the carotid arteries or airway. Uke must tap out!

de.q: Was ist Shime-waza?
opts: Würgetechniken
Haltetechniken
Hebeltechniken
Wurftechniken
de.exp: Shime-waza = Würgetechniken. Druck auf Halsschlagadern oder Luftröhre. Uke tippt aus.

fr.q: Qu'est-ce que le Shime-waza?
opts: Techniques d'étranglement
Techniques d'immobilisation
Techniques de clé
Techniques de projection
fr.exp: Shime-waza = techniques d'étranglement. Pression sur les artères carotides ou la trachée. Uke tape pour abandonner.

es.q: ¿Qué es el Shime-waza?
opts: Técnicas de estrangulamiento
Técnicas de inmovilización
Técnicas de palanca
Técnicas de proyección
es.exp: Shime-waza = técnicas de estrangulamiento. Presión sobre las arterias carótidas o la tráquea. Uke golpea para rendirse.

it.q: Cos'è lo Shime-waza?
opts: Tecniche di strangolamento
Tecniche di immobilizzazione
Tecniche di leva
Tecniche di proiezione

pt.q: O que é Shime-waza?
opts: Técnicas de estrangulamento
Técnicas de imobilização
Técnicas de chave
Técnicas de projeção
pt.exp: Shime-waza = técnicas de estrangulamento. Pressão nas artérias carótidas ou na traqueia. Uke bate para desistir.

Техники удержания
Техники болевых
Техники бросков

sr.q: Protivnik je mnogo teži od tebe. Koji džudo princip koristiš?

Napadaš direktno i koristiš sopstvenu snagu frontalno
Čekaš da se protivnik umori i tek onda napadaš
Igraš pasivno tražeći kaznu Shido za protivnika
sr.exp: Ju no ri! Teži protivnik = više mase za preusmeravanje. Ko-uchi-gari, Tai-otoshi ili Tomoe-nage su idealni – koristiš njegovu masu, ne boriš se s njom.

en.q: Your opponent is much heavier than you. Which judo principle do you apply?
opts: Use the opponent's mass and movement against them applying Ju no ri
Attack directly using your own physical power and strength frontally
Wait passively for the heavier opponent to become tired and slow
Play defensively hoping the opponent collects enough Shido penalties
en.exp: Ju no ri! A heavier opponent = more mass to redirect. Ko-uchi-gari, Tai-otoshi or Tomoe-nage are ideal – use their mass, don't fight it.

sr.q: Dobijaš Shido za pasivnost. Šta radiš odmah?
opts: Napadam agresivno da pokažem aktivnost
Nastavljam pasivan jer se bojim da izgubim
Izlazim iz tatamija
Tražim vremenski odmor
sr.exp: Shido za pasivnost = moraš napasti! Ne čekaj – svaki Shido te približava porazu. Aktivnost je džudo zahtev, ne opcija.

en.q: You receive Shido for passivity. What do you do immediately?
opts: Attack aggressively to show activity
Stay passive because I fear losing
Step off the Tatami
Request a time-out
en.exp: Shido for passivity = you must attack! Don't wait – every Shido brings you closer to defeat. Activity is a judo requirement, not an option.

S'accrocher aussi
Sortir du tatami

Aggrapparsi anche all'avversario senza fare nulla
Uscire dal tatami

Pokušavam direktan napad za Ippon u toj situaciji
Zamenjujem džudo kimono jer je oštećen borbom
Izlazim van zone tatamija radi resetovanja pozicije
sr.exp: Negativan hvat (oba na istom rukavu, bez namere napada) = Shido. Sudija bi trebalo to da primeti. Ako ne, stvori napad iz te pozicije.

en.q: Your opponent holds a negative grip (both hands on the same sleeve). What do you request?
opts: A Shido penalty imposed on them by the referee for negative behaviour
Attempt an immediate throw to score Ippon for yourself
Change into a different kimono to reset the gripping situation
Step outside the contest zone to force a positional reset
en.exp: A negative grip (both hands on the same sleeve, with no intention to attack) = Shido. The referee should notice. If not, create an attack from that position.

sr.q: Šta je razlika između 'Tachi-waza' i 'Sutemi-waza'?
opts: Tachi = bacanje iz stoja, Sutemi = žrtveno bacanje gdje Tori pada
Tachi označava brze, a Sutemi označava spore džudo tehnike
Tachi i Sutemi nemaju tehničku razliku u džudou
Tachi su parterne, a Sutemi su stojeće džudo tehnike
sr.exp: Tachi-waza su stojeća bacanja (Tori ostaje na nogama). Sutemi-waza su žrtvena bacanja (Tori se namerno baca na tatami da baci Uke-a).

en.q: What is the difference between 'Tachi-waza' and 'Sutemi-waza'?
opts: Tachi = standing throw, Sutemi = sacrifice throw where Tori falls
Tachi refers to fast techniques while Sutemi refers to slow ones
Tachi and Sutemi have no meaningful technical difference in judo
Tachi refers to ground techniques while Sutemi means standing
en.exp: Tachi-waza are standing throws (Tori stays on their feet). Sutemi-waza are sacrifice throws (Tori intentionally falls to throw Uke).

de.q: Was ist Sutemi-waza?
opts: Opferwürfe – Tori fällt absichtlich
Standfußwürfe
Bodentechniken
Würgetechniken
de.exp: Sutemi-waza = Opferwürfe. Tori opfert Standfestigkeit, um Uke zu werfen.

fr.q: Qu'est-ce que le Sutemi-waza?
opts: Projections sacrifice – Tori tombe volontairement
Projections debout
Techniques au sol
Techniques d'étranglement au sol
fr.exp: Sutemi-waza = projections sacrifice. Tori sacrifie son équilibre pour projeter Uke.

es.q: ¿Qué es el Sutemi-waza?
opts: Proyecciones de sacrificio – Tori cae voluntariamente
Proyecciones de pie
Técnicas de suelo
Técnicas de estrangulamiento en el suelo
es.exp: Sutemi-waza = proyecciones de sacrificio. Tori sacrifica su equilibrio para proyectar a Uke.

it.q: Cos'è il Sutemi-waza?
opts: Proiezioni di sacrificio – Tori cade volontariamente
Proiezioni in piedi
Tecniche a terra
Tecniche di strangolamento applicate a terra
it.exp: Sutemi-waza = proiezioni di sacrificio. Tori sacrifica il proprio equilibrio per proiettare Uke.

pt.q: O que é Sutemi-waza?

Projeções em pé
Técnicas de solo

de.exp: Mit Waza-ari Vorsprung muss man Angriff und Verteidigung ausbalancieren. Reine Passivität bringt Shido, aber zu viel Aggressivität gibt dem Gegner eine Chance.

es.q: Llevas Waza-ari a 30 segundos del final. ¿Cuál es la táctica más inteligente?

Moverse al borde para gastar tiempo

it.q: Conduci per un Waza-ari con 30 secondi alla fine. Qual è la tattica più intelligente?
